source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension (នាយកដ្ឋានផ្សព្វផ្សាយកសិកម្ម) - "ដំណាំក្រូចពោធិសាត់" (Pursat Orange Cultivation Guide), 2016, 26pp
text:
Keeping the area around each tree free of tall weeds and grass (ការសម្អាតស្មៅ) reduces competition for water and nutrients and removes hiding places for pests. This is usually done with a brush cutter or by hand-weeding on a regular schedule through the growing season.

Care should be taken to avoid letting cutting equipment or any weed-control chemicals contact the trunk or exposed roots of the tree, since wounds to the bark can become entry points for disease.
